press.title: Data for journalists: advertised discounts vs 30-day prices – babl cene
press.desc: Daily figures on advertised discounts in 7 Serbian electronics stores: how many prices are at least 5% below the lowest price of the 30 days before the reduction, by category. CSV and JSON download.
press.intro: Daily figures on advertised discounts on items from {min} din in {n} electronics stores. Data from {d} (last refresh {u}).
press.bycat: By category (the 15 with the most advertised discounts)
press.tbl_note: Shares are of the advertised discounts in the category. “Real” is the average over confirmed reductions only.
method: What is compared: for every item whose crossed-out (previous) price is higher than today's price and that costs at least {min} din, today's price is compared with the lowest price of the 30 days before the reduction, which stores must show as the previous price since 1 May 2026 (Serbian Law on Trade).

Confirmed reduction: today's price is at least 5% below the 30-day low. Above the 30-day low: today's price is more than 2% above it. Not lower than in 30 days: the price is not at least 5% below it and the advertised discount is 10% or more; Close to the 30-day low: the same with an advertised discount under 10%. Unverified: no 30-day low was available. Advertised discount = 1 − price / crossed-out price; real reduction = 1 − price / 30-day low.
The 30-day low is the one the store states. Our own price history is used only for the period before today's price took effect, never for the days of the sale itself.
Data is refreshed 4 times a day: around 04:00 every store's whole catalogue, and at 10:40, 14:40 and 18:40 (Belgrade time) the first pages of every category. Stores: {stores}.

Limits: only items published on the stores' websites are covered, not in-store prices; the same product in several colours or from several sellers counts once; prices can change during the day; reading errors are possible; categories are as the stores file their items.
press.disc: This is a comparison of published prices, not a legal assessment nor a claim about any seller's intentions. “Not lower than in 30 days” only means that, according to the available data, today's price is not at least 5% below the lowest price of the 30 days before the reduction.
press.dl_note: The files change with every refresh. For older data or questions, use the “Report a mistake” link on the site.
